Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Antoni Lueddeke
Message:
docs: DEPLOY-CONFIG.md, one table of production config values (MAP-190)

Deployment-review change #2: every "where is X" for production in one
table with the current value and the one place it is set (script,
workflow line, 1Password item, GitHub setting). Droplet specs, the
Postgres data mount and its ownership (999:999, 0600/0700, mounted by
the postgres container only) and the running containers come from a
read-only SSH read on 2026-10-02, pasted verbatim below the table.

Linked from CLAUDE.md (Production Server; the stale "password in
production .env" line now names the 1Password item) and from
deployment/README.md.
